title: Back again
content: So, I've been lurking in the mall world threads since I joined, and I dont know if it because Im being introduced to so many different perspectives but I saw some weird shiii last night even for me. But basically I was in the mall as usual when I am like transported to a field with picture perfect grass and clouds and a huge willow tree. It's great and all and then I trun around and there is this TERRIFYINGLY mutated purple cow behind like 3 in from my face. When I say this thing is f-up, I mean f-up, and it just stared at me, then I get pulled backwards towards somewhere and the next thing I know im looking at...this thing? It was like a crystallized moving infinity symbol, that was moving in itself but also out and somehow in all directions, while still like it wasn't moving at all. My hands had these threads attached to them that looked like they were made out of golden night( dont know how else to describe it.) And I was jumped to outerspace, where I was on a spaceship, and were in front of this infinitly large but also somehow small enough to fit into you hands orb, that looked like the sun but in different colors that I dont think are on the known color wheel. And we were trying to study in but we could getto close or we would get sacked in. We'll I did, and for a split second I was so lucid in a way I had never been before, I legit thought I transmigrated. Then I woke up and almost had a panic attack because I thought I was dying in space. It was really freaky and I dont know what to do this information now, so thats why im telling strangers on the internet.
